work_orders.title: UPS battery string load test — quarterly
work_orders.description: Standard quarterly battery load test. String 1 showing marginal voltage. Individual cell impedance test recommended.
work_orders.resolution: Load test completed. String voltage 380V (marginal). Recommended impedance test at next PM window.

work_orders.title: UPS cell 14 high temperature investigation
work_orders.description: Cell 14 running 14 degC above ambient. Impedance test shows 12.5 mohm (new spec 4 mohm). Cell degraded.
work_orders.resolution: Cell 14 confirmed degraded. Ordered replacement string. Interim: increased monitoring to weekly. Battery room ventilation verified OK.

work_orders.title: Emergency UPS battery string replacement
work_orders.description: Mains failure on 2 Dec exposed battery weakness. Cell 14 shorted under load. Emergency string replacement.
work_orders.resolution: Full 32-cell VRLA string replaced. Post-install: 384V on load, 15.2 min runtime, all cells < 5 mohm. Old string disposed per SANS 10229.
